title: Joe Oliver's house, his sponsoring her trips, his death and "Caldonia"
summary: She visited Oliver's home in Chicago, he handled her songs and advised on her fee, and she says he died of ptomaine poisoning from sardines, costing her money for "Caldonia".

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
